species.real: Constantine the Great was proclaimed emperor at York in 306 AD, after his father died there, and a statue of him now sits outside York Minster looking quite pleased about it.
species.name: Legionette

dex.text: Marches up and down York's old walls in formation, whistling a tune nobody else can hear. Very polite, and only a little bit ghostly about it.
dex.fact: York was the Roman fortress Eboracum, and Roman legions were stationed there.

species.real: A centurion's badge of rank was a staff of vine wood, the vitis, which he was entitled to use on the backs of slow legionaries.
species.name: Centurion

dex.text: Has the stern look of someone who has never once been late for drill. Stands firm against anything, including the bus.
dex.fact: Roman legions were divided into centuries, and each century was led by a centurion.
